name: Z.ai (GLM)
description: Z.ai cloud chat-completion provider (GLM-4.x / GLM-Z1 / charglm). Claims the 'zai' model prefix (e.g. 'zai/glm-4.6'). Wraps the canonical OAICompatClient from local-oai-provider with Z.ai's defaults (api.z.ai/api/paas/v4). Reads the API key from plugins.z-ai-provider.apiKey or the ZAI_API_KEY env var.
